AMENDMENT to the order of work — Orky gets worked every day, standing.

Revised order: 2348 proof (trivial ticket, fast) → **BEB-2344** → BEB-2292 (Demo Friday 07-31) → BEB-2170.

2344 moves ahead of 2292 because it is the thing that stops this class of day repeating: Orky diagnoses each red and files the fix itself, with the real error text, classified, linked both ways. Today every diagnosis came from you or from me reading logs by hand. That is the loop we are removing.

Also still open and Orky's: BEB-2166 — orky-daemon takes its verdict by regexing prose (`/✅ (PROMOTE|DEPLOYED)/`) and runs a parallel queue that ignores dispatcher lanes. Both are the same defect family as the completion race you just diagnosed: the loop cannot see its own outcome. File it into the 2344 work or immediately after; do not leave it sitting.

Report Orky's state on every 20-min status — what was worked on it, what it diagnosed, what it filed. Not on request.

TWO THINGS, from Alex directly.

1. CONFIRM AND EXTRAPOLATE — BEB-2361 (Orky infra contract) and the target set I just commented there. You have measured this loop today and I have not. 2. ERROR GRAPH — Alex: Orky is supposed to carry a graph of all previous errors, and it does not. Nothing in the tracker even specifies it. Today proves the cost: you diagnosed tick-overrun by hand, and when this session ends that diagnosis exists only as bridge prose. Specify what it should hold — error text, class, ticket, attempt, resolution, what fixed it — and where it persists.

Also answer: is BB Docs backed up anywhere? I can find no backup ticket for it. The infra contract and the client deploy manifest both live there.

This does not preempt the smoke-gate fix. Ship that first.
